relationships.subject: ROS
relationships.evidence_quote: ROS promoted the activation of the TXNIP-NLRP3 pathway in the spinal cord during the development of DNP

relationships.subject: TXNIP
relationships.evidence_quote: TXNIP promoted NLRP3 inflammasome activation, IL-1β secretion, and phosphorylation of NR2B in spinal cords of DNP rats

relationships.subject: PBN
relationships.evidence_quote: The mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia of DNP rats were alleviated after systemic administration of PBN.

relationships.subject: TXNIP
relationships.evidence_quote: the abundance of NLRP3-bound TXNIP was remarkably enhanced in spinal cords of DNP rats compared with rats in control group and painless group

key_findings: Spinal ROS contributes to type 2 diabetic neuropathic pain via TXNIP-NLRP3-NR2B signaling.
In high glucose, microglial BV2 ROS-TXNIP-NLRP3 activation and IL-1beta secretion increased p-NR2B in cocultured PC12 cells.
